title: Word Rotate
description: One word in the sentence keeps changing: a vertical carousel of the words that fit.
usage: For the hero sentence with a variable in it — "Built for dashboards / docs / pricing pages". The words sit in the markup as a stack; the script steps the stack every two seconds and loops it cleanly. Keep the words one length family apart at most, or the sentence breathes oddly as it changes.
a11y: Screen readers get one sentence: the rotating stack is aria-hidden and a visually-hidden static version carries the meaning. The rotation pauses under prefers-reduced-motion, leaving the first word standing.
